purpose: Relation-layer consumption table for dimension-evidence states (dimension-evidence-contract-v1 section 6). Maps dimension states to relation effects; the relation layer reads this file and does not re-encode direction logic in branches. The frozen boundary modality table and RC3.1 relation lattice are untouched.
invariants: UNKNOWN is never upgraded to a compatible state.
AT_MOST_RBI effects cap the relation at RELATED_BUT_INSUFFICIENT unless a positive conflict rule (polarity/modality opposition) fires first.
BLOCKS_ENTAILS applies whenever the state is present, regardless of other compatible states.
No case IDs, no literal case-to-relation maps.
